description.value: The Maury Young Arts Centre is the cultural heart of Whistler Village, operated by Arts Whistler as a registered charity. The facility includes a 200-seat theatre, a mountain-view art gallery, a sprung-floor studio, and the Arthentic boutique selling handcrafted works by local Sea to Sky artists. Cyclists finishing a ride on the Sea to Sky corridor will find rotating exhibitions, live performances, and community events year-round.
